scope: 141 disjoint assigned paths; static current-body AST/source inspection for reusable use cases. No historical code execution, emulator/PINE/process control, ISO reads, production/recipe/registry changes or broad tests. Tests contribute required behavior contracts, not code bodies to migrate.

method.membership: Exactly input.items[].path, each once, current bytes matched current_sha256 before AST parsing and rechecked after report generation. Historical family/purpose hints were used only for navigation; per-file decisions are based on function/class bodies, calls, guards, assertions and top-level effects.
method.evidence: Line numbers refer to current source. Compact function evidence lists observed direct calls; per-file use_case/exception is semantic review. AST parsed every assigned body including methods/nested functions. Repeated verifier variants were separately inspected for selector, window, decoder/normalizer and teardown differences.
method.facades: Followed both sprite-export facades into textures.py without executing; dynamic external hooks and generated transport execution remain explicit unknowns. No automatic retirement or migration credit.
method.not_proof: A static function/call match or common use case does not establish interchangeable contracts, code removal, physical fit, current caller closure or live correctness.

minimum_toolkit_recommendation.engine_policy: Keep transport, input backend, capture/inspection and owned lifecycle as clear responsibilities behind a small runtime toolset. Reuse PID/starttime/ISO-guarded cleanup; never adopt app-wide pkill/flatpak kill or shared log truncation from legacy scenarios.
minimum_toolkit_recommendation.data: Owned profile/socket/device/output configuration, frame parts/diff thresholds, bounded reads and source identity.
minimum_toolkit_recommendation.separate_from: PINE memory writes, uinput physical-style taps and save/load state have different effects. Desktop portal capture and emulator framebuffer capture are different backends with different evidence limits.

minimum_toolkit_recommendation.engine_policy: Represent repeated batch verifications as cohort selector + typed read/decoder/comparison + scenario facts atop owned runtime. Preserve separate fixed-field, narrative, positional-grid, code/hook/capacity and image-state comparisons.

minimum_toolkit_recommendation.separate_from: A normalized RAM string match is not exact controls or visible layout. Test contracts are acceptance data; do not port every test body or dated scenario as a new handler.

strongest_reuse_leads: Most dated live verifiers repeat boot→discover instance→wait for buffer→bounded bulk read→decode/compare→report→teardown. Keep selectors/decoder schema/expected values as scenario data; replace unsafe lifecycle with the existing owned process contract before reuse.

Batch C/D/E application generators repeat command generation, scratch pixel readback, mask containment, checkerboard previews and index updates. Their batch decisions are data, while preservation and refusal ordering belong to shared placement/report flows.

Rendering already reuses make_explainer_png and make_batch_c_png across sheet art. Repeated glyph sizing, layer shifts, fills and containment are candidates; genuine source reconstruction differences should remain explicit algorithms rather than one function per texture.

Test bodies independently expose reusable contracts: late-failure no-write, exact allowed edit union, source preservation, idempotence, ref/argument/opaque-token preservation, complete substitution domains, actual ink calibration, MIPS behavior and runtime PID reuse/attach safety.
unknowns_and_limits: Current manual/external callers, dynamic import targets from arbitrary JSON, active emulator ownership, live source assets and rendered acceptance were not evaluated.

Two records retain explicit dynamic/transport unknowns; all141 files still have a primary responsibility and role. Some source checks rely on real shipping assets or stale pinned fixtures; no tests were executed and no green-suite claim is made.
Counts are this141-path disjoint slice only. Primary roles partition files; capability tags overlap. Historical dated filenames are not the count of distinct capabilities.

No production function/module/handler is proposed per historical path. Data/config extraction is not deletion until complete implementation+data+adapters are measured and the relevant current behavior/callers are verified.

verification.no_execution: Static analysis only; no game/legacy script execution, broad tests or runtime tools.

global_ast_disposition.method: Read compact top_candidates, compare matched function/block bodies against current assigned sources already inspected; no candidate is approved for automatic merge.
